byh-sat-1.webp.zh: 卫星视角：一条长跑道斜穿农田，机坪与机库在跑道中段一侧。
byh-sat-1.webp.en: Satellite view: a long runway cuts diagonally across farmland, with the apron and hangars beside its midpoint.

byh-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 日出时，一架小型单发涡桨飞机停在机坪上，低矮的白色航站楼立在其后，几个人影正走向飞机。
byh-chatgpt-01.webp.en: At sunrise a small single-engine turboprop waits on the apron before a low white terminal, a few figures walking toward it as the sun flares.

byh-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 航拍这座机场：一架白色双发客机孤零零停在巨大空荡的水泥机坪上，远处是白色塔台、水塔与成片树林。
byh-chatgpt-02.webp.en: An aerial view of the field: one white twin-jet airliner alone on a vast empty concrete apron, with the white tower, water tower and woods beyond.

byh-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 白色塔台挂着彩色徽标，旁边是低矮的单层办公楼与大片草坪，前景是刷着白线的宽阔机坪，停车位空无一人。
byh-chatgpt-03.webp.en: The white tower carries a small emblem, with a low single-storey office block and lawns beside it and a broad line-marked apron empty in the foreground.
